lines: Fire, moon, sun — Brahmā, Viṣṇu — still things, moving things: Your very stuff.
To the many-shaped — to You, shaped of knowing — bow.
sanskrit_cite: agnīṣomaravibrahmaviṣṇusthāvarajaṅgama | svarūpa bahurūpāya namaḥ saṃvinmayāya te

lines: To the great fire — universe for fuel, bright with great ash smeared pure —
to Thee, the Becoming, whose one offering is the world — bow.
sanskrit_cite: viśvendhanamahākṣārānulepaśucivarcase | mahānalāya bhavate viśvaikahaviṣe namaḥ

lines: To Śiva's fire — cool, thick with highest nectar —
and to some Unequalled, all-devouring when the world burns — homage be to Thee.
sanskrit_cite: paramāmṛtasāndrāya śītalāya śivāgnaye | kasmai cid viśvasaṃploṣaviṣamāya namo 'stu te

lines: To Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva — to Thee, even as Great-Lord — bow.
And to some mantra-bodied one — bow.
sanskrit_cite: mahādevāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te | maheśvarāyāpi namaḥ kasmai cin mantramūrtaye

lines: Bow — to Śiva's fire: cut, sucked dry, the three worlds' melted fat His unction —
unequalled though He be, yet kind.
sanskrit_cite: namo nikṛttaniḥśoṣatrailokyavigaladvasā- | vasekaviṣamāyāpi maṅgalāya śivāgnaye

lines: Whose mark is this alone — that no marks meet —
to Him, to God, to gracious some Śambhu — homage be.
sanskrit_cite: samastalakṣanāyoga eva yasyopalakṣaṇam | tasmai namo 'stu devāya kasmai cid api śambhave

lines: To Him against Veda and Āgama, maker of Veda and Āgama, their true essence —
to the hidden Master — bow.
sanskrit_cite: vedāgamaviruddhāya vedāgamavidhāyine | vedāgamasatattvāya guhyāya svāmine namaḥ

lines: Sole maker of the world-round — and its sole unmaker;
round-shaped, round-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
sanskrit_cite: saṃsāraikanimittāya saṃsāraikavirodhine | namaḥ samsārarūpāya niḥsaṃsārāya śambhave

lines: To root, middle, tip; shaped as root-middle-tip; tip-middle-root outworn —
to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
sanskrit_cite: mūlāya madhyāyāgrāya mūlamadhyāgramūrtaye | kṣīnāgramadhyamūlāya namaḥ pūrṇāya śambhave

lines: Bow — that taking of the Name, even once, IS merit-heaps ripened.
To Him, Śiva, hard to win — to Thee.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sukṛtasaṃbharavipākaḥ sakṛd apy asau | yasya nāmagrahas tasmai durlabhāya śivāya te

lines: Bow — amid heaped crowds of moving and unmoving shapes, ever playing for Thee, the One —
knowing-shaped, skull-wearing.
sanskrit_cite: namaścarācarākāraparetanicayaiḥ sadā | krīḍate tubhyam ekasmai cinmayāya kapāline

lines: To the trickster, the pure; the hidden, the self-shown; the fine, the all-shaped — bow —
to Śambhu, wonder-variegated.
sanskrit_cite: māyāvine viśuddhāya guhyāya prakaṭātmane | sūkṣmāya viśvarūpāya namaś citrāya śambhave
notes: citra holds wonder and variegated at once; kept double.

lines: To all-might — whose sport unmakes the world arrayed by Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu —
wonder to be worked — bow to Thee.
sanskrit_cite: brahmendraviṣṇunirvyūḍhajagatsaṃhārakelaye | āścaryakaraṇīyāya namas te sarvaśaktaye

lines: Those powers and powers are won by shore-roamers only — roamers of His shores.
Bow to Thee — O fathomless Hara-sea.
sanskrit_cite: taṭeṣv eva paribhrāntaiḥ labdhās tās tā vibhūtayaḥ | yasya tasmai namas tubhyam agādhaharasindhave

lines: Dwelling deep in the mud of the Māyā-thick world — unsmeared —
bow to the shining hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus.
sanskrit_cite: māyāmayajagatsāndrapaṅkamadhyādhivāsine | alepāya namaḥ śambhuśatapatrāya śobhine

lines: To the kind, the pure; treasure; self-adorned; dear; last-real; highest —
to Thee — bow.
sanskrit_cite: maṅgalāya pavitrāya nidhaye bhūṣaṇātmane | priyāya paramārthāya sarvotkṛṣṭāya te namaḥ

lines: Bow to the ever-bound, ever sharing freedom; lacking bond and freedom both —
to some Śambhu even — bow.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ satatabaddhāya nityanirmuktibhāgine | bandhamokṣavihīnāya kasmai ci d api śambhave

lines: In all this three-world, whose whole stuff is jeering —
to Thee alone, secondless, ever throned in bliss — bow.
sanskrit_cite: upahāsaikasāre 'sminn etāvati jagattraye | tubhyam evādvitīyāya namo nityasukhāsine

lines: Heart of right-rite, lover of left-rite; all-rite, Śarva, rite-free —
to Thee — bow.
sanskrit_cite: dakṣiṇācārasārāya vāmācārābhilāṣiṇe | sarvācārāya śarvāya nirācārāya te namaḥ

lines: Be it how it may — whoever is worshipped, wherever honored — whoever, whichever god that be —
to him let homage be: to Thee.
sanskrit_cite: yathā tathāpi yaḥ pūjyo yatra tatrāpi yo 'rcitaḥ | yo 'pi vā so 'pi vā yo 'sau devas tasmai namo 'stu te

lines: Served by release-hungers, thief of every fever; spread loveliness at its choicest —
boon-giver — bow to Thee.
sanskrit_cite: mumukṣujanasevyāya sarvasantāpahāriṇe | namo vitatalāvaṇyavarāya varadāya te
notes: vara puns choicest and boon-giver; hārin kept as thief.

lines: Always — three worlds brimmed with unbroken bliss-sap —
bow to Thee, Master of the feast that never ends.
sanskrit_cite: sadā nirantarānandarasanirbharitākhila- | trilokāya namas tubhyaṃ svāmine nityaparvaṇe
notes: parvan kept as feast-day: festival as ontology, not occasion.

lines: Whatever courts Thee — Thee indeed — through pleasure-first tastes, enjoying —
to that dread power-ring of Thine — homage to Thee.
sanskrit_cite: sukhapradhānasaṃvedyasambhogair bhajate ca yat | tvām eva tasmai ghorāya śaktivṛndāya te namaḥ
notes: bhaj kept as court: the powers court Him, we bow to them.

lines: Past even sages' knowing — yet those love-yoked in gesture hold Him fast.
To that some Becoming — bow.
sanskrit_cite: munīnām apy avijñeyaṃ bhaktisambandhaceṣṭitāḥ | āliṅganty api yaṃ tasmai kasmai cid bhavate namaḥ

lines: To highest-nectar's sheath, highest-nectar's heap;
reached past all beyond and no-beyond — to Becoming — bow.
sanskrit_cite: paramāmṛtakośāya paramāmṛtarāśaye | sarvapāramyapāramyaprāpyāya bhavate namaḥ

lines: Mantra through and through — I praise Thy form:
clear, cool, lovely with unheard joy, lush with highest-nectar sap.
sanskrit_cite: mahāmantramayaṃ naumi rūpaṃ te svacchaśītalam | apūrvamodasubhagaṃ parāmṛtarasolvaṇam

lines: On oneness-fame's wide canvas, grounded in freedom-nectar's fullness —
where, Lord, wonder simply isn't — that I praise: Thy teaching.
sanskrit_cite: svātantryāmṛtapūrṇatvad aikyakhyātimahāpaṭe | citraṃ nāsty eva yatreśa tan naumi tava śāsanam
notes: paṭa read as painter's canvas; pūrṇatvāt as its ground.

lines: Thunderbolt to every doubt, doomsday-fire to all ill-luck, aeon-end to joylessness —
we bow the Great-Lord road.
sanskrit_cite: sarvāśaṅkāsaniṃ sarvālakṣmīkālānalaṃ tathā | sarvāmaṅgalyakalpāntaṃ mārgaṃ māheśvaraṃ numaḥ
notes: Lakshmanjoo witness: alakṣmī as ill-luck/poverty; numaḥ kept plural — our bowing is the path.

lines: Hail, God! Bow on bow to Thee; all this world leans on Thee;
Thou — worlds' high Lord, One supreme — I am come to Thee for shelter.
sanskrit_cite: jaya deva namo namo 'stu te sakalaṃ viśvam idaṃ tavāśritam | jagatāṃ parameśvaro bhavān paramekaḥ śaraṇāgato 'smi te
